raw.title: Account Executive - DoW
raw.excerpt: Virtualitics is the category leader in AI-native readiness applications for defense, government, and critical infrastructure.
raw.description:
Virtualitics is the category leader in AI-native readiness applications for defense, government, and critical infrastructure. Founded on a decade of Caltech research in partnership with NASA/JPL, we are led by scientists, strategists, and servicemembers united by a single mission: to solve the world’s most complex, mission-critical challenges with AI.

Our Readiness AI solutions deliver operational certainty — giving leaders and operators a clear picture of what’s ready, what’s at risk, and what to do next. By identifying risks early, diagnosing root causes, and recommending prioritized actions with transparent, explainable AI, we help organizations move from data complexity to decision advantage.

Behind that impact is relentless innovation. Inventors at heart, we hold 15+ U.S. patents and are leading the shift toward agent-driven readiness. But what truly sets us apart is our culture — relentless about results, grounded in transparency, and driven by compassion for the mission and the people it serves.

If you’re motivated by impact, inspired by technical depth, and ready to build AI that performs where it matters most — you’ll find your mission here.

Position Overview

Virtualitics is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Sales Account Executive to join our Federal Sales team and Go-To-Market (GTM) Organization. This individual will be a key driver of our growth within the Department of War (DoW), focusing on Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications that directly impact military readiness. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker, aggressive and outcome oriented, with a proven track record of selling complex AI software solutions into the DoW space and a deep understanding of the challenges facing the Dept. of War in areas of sustainment, logistics, and operational availability. Reporting directly to the Sales Director within GTM Organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Drive the entire sales process from initial prospecting and opportunity identification to contract negotiation and closing. Build and manage a robust sales pipeline to meet and exceed annual sales targets & Qtrly deal stage KPI’s.

  • Sales Account Management: Develop and execute comprehensive account strategies to penetrate key DoW agencies and commands. Identify key stakeholders, understand their challenges, and map our solutions to their critical readiness missions.

  • Customer Relationship Building: Establish and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with decision-makers, influencers, and end-users within the DoW.

  • Solution-Oriented Selling: Act as a trusted advisor to clients by deeply understanding their specific readiness needs across various domains, including:

    • Aircraft, ship, and ground vehicle asset availability and sustainment operations.

    • Medical device and personnel readiness of the total force.

    • Materiel storage, warehousing management, and supply chain logistics for specialized equipment.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with the Virtualitics pre-sales engineering/solutions, marketing, Acct Mgmt, and product teams to create and deliver compelling demonstrations, proposals, and RFI/RFP responses that effectively communicate our value proposition.

  • Market Intelligence: Stay current on DoW trends, procurement processes, and competitive landscape to effectively position Virtualitics' solutions.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Required:

    • 7+ years of successful experience in a quota-carrying Federal Account Executive role, with a strong preference for experience within the DoW..

    • Demonstrated experience selling enterprise software, AI/ML, data analytics, or similar complex technology solutions.

    • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic account plans and manage complex sales cycles. Strong understanding of procurement & contracting for AI software acquisition process.

    • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate a complex value proposition to a technical and non-technical audience.

    • Self-starter with the ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.

    • Willingness to travel 40-50% as required to engage with DoW agencies and commands.

  • Preferred:

    • Existing relationships within DoW logistics, sustainment, or readiness communities (e.g., USAF Air Force Materiel Command (AFMC), Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC), Air Force Sustainment Center (AFSC) , Air Combat Command (ACC) , Air Mobility Command (AMC) , Space Operations Command (SpOC), Air Force Chief Data Office / DoW CDAO AFWERX / DIU / Rapid Capabilities Office)
      (ie. Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP), Marine Corps Logistics Command (MARCORLOGCOM), Army Materiel Command (AMC), Army Sustainment Command (ASC), Transformation & Training Command (T2COM), HQDA G/3/5/7, etc.

    • Understanding of government contracting and procurement vehicles.

    • Experience with MEDDIC/MEDPIC, Challenger, or other solution-selling methodologies.

    • Active security clearance or the ability to obtain one.

    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance (interim and/or final). Continued employment is contingent upon the successful adjudication of this clearance; failure to obtain or maintain the required level of access may result in rescission of the job offer or termination of employment.

Compensation

We offer:

  • Competitive base salary based on experience

  • Lucrative Commission Plan (50/50 sales plan)

  • 100% employer paid health benefit premiums (medical, dental, vision)

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

  • Paid Time Off for National Holidays

  • Stock options at sign-on

  • 401k plan

  • Company equipment (Mac/PC and iPhone)

  • Remote work from home

raw.description:
Marks, part of the Propelis Group, Marks is a consumer experience agency creating engaging moments across the entire brand spectrum—from brand design and packaging, to content and consumer connections. We are a collaborative global network of 1,900+ team members across 25+ studios and 20+ countries, partnering with some of the world’s most recognized brands to solve complex business challenges through design, strategy, and craft.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Senior Copywriter, Brand Experience crafts engaging, original brand and product storytelling for a wide variety of brands, audiences, and channels. Reporting to the Sr Director of Storytelling, you’ll partner with other teams regularly, collaborating on any number of project types from writing scripts and social media posts to conceptualizing campaigns and experiential marketing. You’ll be counted on to provide ACDs and/or CDs with options and ideas in order to inspire, define, and build out large-scale concepts, campaigns, or other client deliverables. Where necessary, you’ll also step in to lead basic- to intermediate-level copy projects, developing on-strategy conceptual approaches for client creative briefs across a range of applications and programs. The ideal candidate has agency or in-house brand marketing experience, a keen eye for detail, and a proven track record of delivering compelling copy for a range of brand voices under tight timelines.

PLEASE NOTE: This open role is for our part-time Flex Force bench. As a Flex Force employee, you’ll work on a project-by-project basis as needed. You’ll also have the flexibility to work from home, but may be invited to come into a Marks studio on occasion to join in-person collaborative sessions, if available and close to one of our locations.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensures accurate, consistent, and timely completion of basic- to intermediate- level client copywriting deliverables within budget, based on objectives and concepts established by the client or team leadership
  • Adapts writing tonality to a wide variety of brands and audiences, undertaking research where necessary to better understand a brand or their target audience
  • Always meets quality standards and defined timelines for all assigned deliverables and makes recommendations to management for improvements in content, tools, processes and/or assigned tasks
  • Presents and participates in collaborative meetings with internal teams to help elevate ideas and collectively find the best answer to the clients’ ask
  • Shows up consistently with strong analytical, prioritizing, interpersonal, problem-solving, time management, and planning skills

About Propelis: Propelis is a portfolio of global marketing services and technology companies with a combined legacy of 150+ years, 2,000+ clients, 9,000 employees, and operations across 30 countries. Propelis provides the scale and support of a global organization while preserving the unique culture and identity of each company in its portfolio.

For more information visit: www.MakeMarks.com

Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from talent@bixal.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at talent@bixal.com and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular workweek and on the next business day during weekends or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Principal Cloud & DevSecOps Architect to serve as a senior technical authority across our federal delivery programs. This role owns end-to-end cloud and DevSecOps architecture, drives platform strategy, and provides hands-on technical leadership to engineering teams. The ideal candidate is a deeply experienced architect and natural communicator who earns trust with clients and teams through technical credibility, and who can also contribute meaningfully to technical solutioning and proposal efforts when called upon.

Location:

This is a fully remote position. Must be legally authorized to work in the US. Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $178,000 – $195,000. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

Business Development Support

  • Contribute to technical solutioning for select pursuits, helping shape win themes through architecture and delivery approach

  • Support technical proposal content and participate in client-facing discussions or presentations as needed

Enterprise Architecture & DevSecOps Strategy

  • Define and own cloud architecture and DevSecOps strategy across active delivery programs and new pursuits

  • Design secure, scalable, cloud-native platforms encompassing CI/CD, IaC, container orchestration, identity/access management, and observability

  • Establish architecture standards, reusable patterns, and technical governance aligned with federal security and compliance expectations (NIST/FISMA/FedRAMP)

Engineering Leadership & Modernization

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership through architecture reviews, design decisions, and mentoring of engineers

  • Lead modernization efforts including legacy-to-cloud migrations, platform hardening, automation, reliability improvements, and AI integration

  • Ensure solutions meet quality, performance, and compliance requirements across complex federal environments

  • Serve as a trusted technical voice with clients, communicating architecture decisions, trade-offs, and recommendations with clarity at all levels

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in cloud engineering, DevSecOps, platform engineering, SRE, or technical architecture

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

  • Experience supporting and/or leading federal proposals with solutioning, writing, technical challenges, etc.

  • Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end cloud architecture and delivery outcomes in complex environments

  • Deep experience with one or more cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern DevOps practices including IaC, CI/CD, and containers/Kubernetes

  • Strong understanding of secure delivery and compliance-driven environments; ability to embed DevSecOps into the SDLC

  • Excellent communication skills, able to convey complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and/or enterprise architecture credentials

  • Experience working Databricks, Databricks certification, or experience setting up environments to integrate and work with Databricks.

  • Experience building reusable platform patterns that accelerate delivery across multiple teams

  • Active participation in DevSecOps or cloud communities, with recent thought leadership activities.

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

title: Provider Network Evaluator I-HCBS (Full-time Remote, North Carolina Based)
description: Provider Network Evaluator I (PNE I) is a QP level professional that works as part of the Provider Network Evaluation Department.

raw.title: Provider Network Evaluator I-HCBS (Full-time Remote, North Carolina Based)
raw.excerpt: Provider Network Evaluator I (PNE I) is a QP level professional that works as part of the Provider Network Evaluation Department.
raw.description:
Provider Network Evaluator I (PNE I) is a QP level professional that works as part of the Provider Network Evaluation Department. The department has the responsibility for ensuring that providers are properly delivering services to Alliance members and their families and ensures any out of compliance findings are addressed in a timely manner.

The PNE I-HCBS position will be assigned to the Home and Community Based Services (HCBS) team. This team is responsible for conducting reviews of Unlicensed Alternatives to Family Living placements for Alliance members and reviews of member self-directed services (Employee of Record) as described in CCP8P, Attachment H. The PNE I will also be involved in ensuring that HCBS final rule requirements are followed, to include ensuring validation of agency self-assessments and that member surveys are remediated when follow-up is required.

We are currently seeking to fill two openings; one in the Mecklenburg County area and another in Wake County area. This position is full-time remote but does require travel to conduct on-site reviews and monitoring. The selected candidate must reside in North Carolina.

Responsibilities & Duties

Validate and Approve TBI, Innovation Waiver, 1915(i), and LTCS Sites and Services

Review and validate service site documentation for TBI, Innovation Waiver, 1915(i), and LTCS programs; confirm compliance with regulatory standards to authorize member access to new or existing service locations

Perform HCBS reviews as required and within the required timeframes

Review provider policies and procedures for compliance with CMS mandated HCBS standards

Review and manage HCBS portal to ensure portal entries are reviewed and accepted prior to service initiation and move in

Collaborate with other MCOs when a member is transferred into the Alliance catchment area or transferred out of the Alliance catchment area

Work with providers to ensure out of compliance findings are remedied either by providing technical assistance and/or through a plan of correction

Work with I/DD Care Coordination, Provider Network Development and agency providers to ensure sites are validated and in compliance

Remediate issues and concerns that are identified by the State with MIE surveys through documentation review, technical assistance with providers and other stakeholders, and collaboration with I/DD Care Coordinators

Provide reports and updates on outcomes of reviews of HCBS and the potential impact on consumers involved to the Provider Network Evaluator Supervisor and/or the Director of Network Evaluation

Review and Monitor Individual and Family Directed Services

  • Review self-directed services (Employer of Record) on an annual basis as required
  • Provide technical assistance when required to ensure compliance with CCP8-P, Attachment H and other mandated requirements
  • Maintain EOR spreadsheet

Assist With Department Policies, Procedures, and Standards

  • Assist in the development and maintenance of standards for HCBS and unlicensed AFLs sites, Individual and Family Directed Services (IFDS), quality improvement and evaluating the delivery of services to consumers and families
  • Assist in the development of monitoring policies and procedures and site validation
  • Assist in the development of MIE survey processes and procedures

Provide Monitoring Information for Inclusion in Provider Database

  • Maintain a current database of HCBS sites that require monitoring and review
  • Maintain a database of unlicensed AFL sites that require annual reviews. Work with I/DD care coordination as needed to update the database to capture sites that are new and sites that are no longer serving members
  • Help maintain the database to ensure accuracy
  • Track any discrepancies and errors in State required reports and reconcile as needed to ensure sites are validated and there are no disruptions in services
  • Track I/DD Care Coordination HCBS assessments/reviews and communicate any discrepancies as needed

Maintain Knowledge of Current Services and Supports Available

  • Acquire and maintain knowledge of the current services and supports available within the catchment area and available to consumers within North Carolina

Participate in Investigations and Focused Reviews

  • In limited instances, the PNE I may be asked to participate in investigations and focused reviews when there are concerns about quality of care and health and safety

Travel

  • Travel between Alliance offices, attending meetings on behalf of Alliance, participating in Alliance sponsored events, etc. may be required
  • Travel to review sites, meet with members, providers, stakeholders, and attend court hearings etc. is required

Minimum Requirements

Education & Experience

A bachelor’s degree in a Human Service field (such as Psychology, Social Work, etc.) and at least five (5) years of progressive experience in the field of I/DD or TBI.

Strong knowledge of I/DD and TBI services required. Experience with Home Based and Community Services (HCBS) is highly desired.

Must maintain a valid driver’s license and a good driving record.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Working knowledge of federal and state statutes, rules, definitions and regulations that govern MHDDSAS services
  • Knowledge of all disability areas including Mental Health, Developmental Disabilities and Substance Abuse
  • Extensive knowledge of I/DD and TBI services and requirements
  • Knowledge and understanding of the principles, concepts and Best Practices used in the treatment, habilitation and support of individuals with needs in any of the disability areas.
  • High level of diplomacy and discretion
  • Strong mediation skills
  • Excellent team building skills
  • Effective communication skills
  • Microsoft Office skills
  • Ability to identify/analyze administrative problems pertinent to the contract
  • Ability to make independent judgments, logical conclusions, recommendations and decisions
  • Ability to determine the appropriate course of action in an emergency or stressful situation

fal is seeking a highly skilled Technical Support Engineer to provide high-quality support and service to our Customer base and Internal teams. At fal, you’ll join a rapidly scaling company defining how AI moves from experimentation to production. This is an opportunity to shape the future of enterprise AI adoption while building deep relationships with customers who are transforming their industries through intelligent technology.

  • Interesting and challenging work

Job Summary
We are looking for a Service Mesh Engineer to design, deploy, and operate service mesh platforms — primarily Istio and Linkerd — that provide secure, observable, and reliable service-to-service communication across our Kubernetes estate. The role focuses on platform engineering, mesh adoption, mTLS, traffic policy, and helping application teams reap the benefits of a mesh without paying for unnecessary complexity. The ideal candidate has operated service mesh in production, deeply understands Envoy and the data plane, and brings both platform engineering discipline and pragmatic adoption strategies.

raw.description:
senior product designer

We're looking for a senior product designer who can hold two things at once: the visual craft to design interfaces that designers will respect, and the systems that make those interfaces work as part of a coherent, scalable product that pushes the limits of what's possible on the web.

The role spans both worlds—designing the editor itself, where most patterns have to be invented rather than borrowed, and designing the more conventional surfaces around it (profile, onboarding, marketing-adjacent flows, etc.) where we still want our own voice to come through. Both require a strong understanding of business impact: working with metrics, analytics, and experiments.

This is a fully remote collaboration under a service agreement. We work primarily within the GMT+1 time zone and expect a regular overlap of business hours on weekdays to allow for meetings and live collaboration.

Who we are

Readymag is a design tool for creating websites, portfolios, editorials, and presentations. We build for designers who treat the web as a creative medium, not a constraint to work around.

Most tools follow the rules of the web. We prefer to question them. Since 2012, we've been inventing capabilities that go the extra mile: animation and interaction systems that give designers full expressive control, layout logic that thinks beyond the grid, typography tools with the precision of professional print software. Working in Readymag feels like creating something, not filling out a form.

We're bootstrapped—a fully distributed team, independent by design, sustainable by choice. We value curiosity, authorship, and a culture of questions. We measure what we can, and trust craft where we can't.

What you will do

  • Own features end-to-end, from early exploration through specs and production handoff;
  • Use Readymag as your primary lens: spot friction, notice inconsistencies, and advocate for improvements as someone who works with the product daily;
  • Prototype ideas quickly: in Figma, in code, or whatever gets the point across fastest;
  • Collaborate with engineers on technical and architectural decisions;
  • Contribute to and extend the design system, keeping it tightly aligned with how things are built in code;
  • Work with data, run experiments, and use research to make informed decisions;
  • Contribute to strategic direction and roadmap alongside product and design leadership.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in product design, preferably in complex technical industries;
  • Strong ownership and an end-to-end approach—you can take a feature from ambiguous brief to shipped without losing the thread;
  • A portfolio that shows range: complex product problems solved with clarity, and an eye for visual quality that designers will notice;
  • You think in systems and work closely with engineers—you’re comfortable in technical conversations, not just design reviews.

Would be a plus

  • Meaningful experience with tools, creative software, or other canvas-based, interaction-heavy products
  • A feel for interface animation—not just transitions for their own sake, but motion that communicates state, guides attention, and makes a complex tool feel alive.

How to apply

Please use our application form to submit your CV and other necessary details. The form includes mandatory fields, and providing the requested information will be enough for us to review your application. In the "address" field, just indicating your country will be sufficient. If your experience matches our requirements, we'll reach out to schedule the next steps.

Thank you!

Position Summary

Join GW MFA and be part of a high-impact team supporting enterprise-wide integration for a leading academic medical organization. This role is ideal for an Epic Bridges-certified professional who thrives in complex environments and enjoys building, optimizing, and supporting critical HL7 interfaces that directly impact patient care and system performance.

The Epic Senior Systems Analyst, Interfaces/Bridges is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and ongoing support of HL7 interfaces for the Epic EHR and third-party systems across the enterprise. This role ensures seamless, accurate, and secure data exchange between Epic and multiple ancillary systems.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical expertise in HL7 and interface development, along with the ability to understand operational workflows and translate business needs into effective system solutions.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other duties may be assigned.
  • Develop and support HL7 interfaces for the Epic EHR and ancillary systems
  • Design, build, test, and deploy interfaces using Epic Bridges and HL7 standards
  • Monitor and maintain interface performance, ensuring data integrity and timely message processing
  • Troubleshoot and resolve interface errors, message failures, and data discrepancies
  • Perform HL7 message mapping, transformation, and validation (ADT, ORM, ORU, SIU, etc.)
  • Review Epic release updates and implement required interface changes
  • Support interface engine maintenance, upgrades, and enhancements
  • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to support integrations and resolve issues
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date interface documentation and standard operating procedures
  • Participate in system testing, including unit, integration, and user acceptance testing
  • Ensure compliance with healthcare data standards, security, and interoperability requirements

Minimum Qualifications

Education
  • Associate's degree or higher from an accredited institution, preferably in Information Technology, Healthcare Administration, or a related field

Licenses/Certifications

  • Epic Bridges Certification

Experience

  • Prior professional experience developing and supporting interfaces within the Epic EHR environment and ancillary applications
  • Strong experience with HL7 interface design, development, and support
  • Proven experience building and maintaining HL7 message types (ADT, Orders, Results, Scheduling, etc.)
  • Prior professional experience with Epic Bridges interface development and support
  • Prior professional experience with an integration engine such as InterSystems IRIS for Health
  • Prior professional experience with HL7 data mapping and transformation
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
Physical Requirements
  • Walk, bend, twist, and reach above shoulder frequently in an office setting
  • Must be able to occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull up to 20 lbs. as part of the role
  • Regularly exposed to healthcare setting that may require personal protective equipment
  • Requires manual dexterity to operate computer keyboard, calculator, copier machine, and other equipment

About GW MFA

MFA physicians provide comprehensive patient care, offering one practice for the whole person with 52 medical and surgical specialties. As members of the GW School of Medicine and Health Sciences faculty, MFA providers are teachers and mentors for medical students, residents, fellows, and researchers, preserving the rich tradition of academics, research, and healing. In addition to maintaining a closely integrated alliance with The George Washington University and The George Washington University Hospital (GWUH), which is separately owned and operated by Universal Health Services (UHS), the GW MFA has active referring relationships with 12 area hospitals.

The GW MFA’s leading healthcare presence in the DC metro region is complemented by a network of community-based practices in DC, Maryland, and Virginia. Given its geographic location in central NW Washington, DC, and proximity to more than 175 resident embassies, the MFA continues to evolve its international clinical outreach.

our ideal candidate would have:

Your Mission

You are accountable for retention, expansion, and recurring revenue growth across Crisalix’s customer base.

Your primary objectives are to:

  • Drive predictable renewal, upsell, and cross-sell revenue.

  • Ensure every client delivers measurable ROI and business growth.

  • Build a high-performing Customer Success organization with strong commercial discipline.

  • Partner closely with Sales to align forecasting, pipeline, and growth strategy.

  • Partner with Sales leadership on forecasting and revenue planning.

  • Drive CRM & Tool Innovation: Collaborate closely with the development team to adapt and improve the CRM and related client-facing tools, ensuring the Customer Success team has best-in-class technology for analytics, automation, and client insights.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Own post-sales revenue performance, including renewals, expansion, and account growth.

  • Define and execute the company-wide Customer Success strategy, directly supporting Crisalix’s retention, expansion, and growth objectives—including measurable growth for every clinic.

  • Own all Customer Success metrics—client ROI, clinic growth, adoption, retention, NPS, revenue expansion, customer satisfaction, and time-to-value.

  • You leave no customer behind—dedicating relentless effort to ensure every client’s success, unlocking unlimited upsell and cross-sell opportunities through exceptional service and partnership

  • Lead onboarding and ongoing training for clients, setting new standards and best practices.

Driving Client Value & Clinic Growth

  • Personally manage select key accounts and clinics to demonstrate excellence, identify new value opportunities, and set best practices.

Voice of the Customer

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Co-develop strategies with Sales for revenue expansion, customer engagement, and measurable clinic business growth.

Executive Reporting

Are you a German language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of linguistic discovery. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline communication for German speakers everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for German language specialists who live and breathe German grammar, syntax, morphology, phonology, semantics, and pragmatics. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like verb conjugation, case system (nominative, accusative, dative, genitive), word order, declensions, gender, and stylistic variation—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on language scenarios, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A master’s or PhD in German language, linguistics, or a closely related field is ideal; peer‑reviewed publications, teaching experience, or hands-on linguistic analysis projects signal fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your German language expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $6-to- $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

Founded by industry veterans and entrepreneurs, and backed by leading investors, we’re assembling our core team. Joining Entity at this stage is a rare opportunity to help shape the future of gaming.

We're looking for a designer who wants to help shape what Entity looks and feels like - across product UI, brand, and how we show up everywhere.
This isn't a role for someone who wants to play it safe. We're building something that doesn't exist yet but should, and we want someone who finds that exciting rather than scary. Someone with a genuine point of view on what design can be, who wants to push it somewhere new.

What you'll be working on

  • Product UI designs/assets across our games platforms on web and mobile
  • Helping define the Entity brand and how it looks and feels across everything we make
  • Marketing assets, social content, and campaign materials

What we're looking for:

  • A strong graphic design and UI design portfolio (required — please don't apply without one)

  • A real interest in video games and the world around them

Nice to haves:

To apply, send us your portfolio and answer a couple of questions (in your voice please, no AI).

We place a strong emphasis on individual responsibility to manage time and work, enabling employees to accommodate their personal life requirements.

Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, industry events, or visits to game development studios. Some flexibility in working hours may be necessary to accommodate meetings with international partners or developers in different time zones.

raw.description:
about the role

This is a product role with a strong emphasis on building. The expectation is not that you manage a roadmap and hand requirements to an engineering team, it is that you are an active participant in what gets built, capable of moving from problem to working prototype using AI-native tools, and doing so throughout the role, not just in the early months.
Otonomee is building AI capability across three areas: tools that improve how the business operates internally, tools that make frontline agents more effective, and selective client-facing tools where there is a clear case that no existing platform can meet the need. This role owns the product decisions across all three and is hands-on in delivering them.
The role requires genuine CX and BPO industry experience. The AI tools being built are for contact centre environments and support operations. Understanding that world from the inside, not just from the software layer above it, is essential. The product decisions this role makes need to be grounded in operational reality.
The role reports directly to the CEO and works closely with the CTO and the broader Senior Leadership Team. Stakeholder management across internal teams and external technology partners is a meaningful part of the role throughout.

Why This Role

This is an early and consequential role in a business that is building its AI and product capability from the ground up. You will have direct access to the CEO, work across a real client base in the CX space, and have genuine ownership of what gets built and how.
If you have the background and are interested in exploring this further, we welcome the conversation.

What You’ll Own


Product decisions: build, buy, advise, partner
Every AI and technology capability decision at Otonomee runs through one of four categories. This role owns that decision framework and applies it consistently.
  • Build: Define what Otonomee builds, write the requirements, and be an active participant in delivering it alongside the engineering team.
  • Buy: Identify where an existing tool is the right answer, evaluate options, and own the decision and the vendor relationship where relevant.
  • Advise: Identify where clients or internal teams have unconfigured capability within their existing platforms and recommend how to activate it, without building something new.
  • Partner: Work with Otonomee's technology partners to understand what their platforms can deliver, ensuring Otonomee is positioned to implement and optimise effectively, and feed partner capability into product decisions.

Hands-on building

Building is a core and permanent expectation of this role, not a transitional phase.
  • Use AI-native build tools to produce working prototypes and deployable tools, moving quickly from problem to output.
  • Work alongside the engineering team on more complex builds, contributing at the product and specification level and reviewing output with enough technical confidence to hold the bar.
  • Maintain a practical understanding of what modern CX platforms can and cannot do natively, so build decisions are always informed by what already exists.

Stakeholder management

This role operates across a range of internal and external relationships that require consistent investment.
  • Work across the Senior Leadership Team to understand operational priorities, translate them into product requirements, and maintain alignment on what is being built and why.
  • Manage the relationship with Otonomee's key technology partners at a working level: certifications, implementation capability, and joint delivery where relevant.
  • Support the Professional Services function with product intelligence: what the build agenda covers, what clients can configure themselves, and where a PS engagement is the right answer versus a product build.

your profile

Hands-on product building experience

  • You have worked in a product role where building was part of the job, not just specifying. You have shipped tools or products using AI-native build environments and can demonstrate this.
  • You are comfortable using tools such as Claude Code,Cowork, Cursor, or Replit to move from idea to working prototype.

BPO or CX industry experience

  • You have worked in a BPO, a CX technology platform, or a business whose core product is customer experience delivery or tooling.
  • You understand the operational reality of a contact centre or support function from the inside, not just from the software layer above it. The tools built in this role are for people working in that environment and the product decisions need to reflect that.

Stakeholder management capability

  • You have worked effectively across internal teams and with external technology partners, managing relationships that require sustained attention and commercial awareness.
  • You can communicate clearly at a senior level, present product decisions with confidence, and hold your position under questioning without being inflexible.

Product management foundation

  • You have worked in a product management capacity and understand how to move from problem to requirement to delivered output in a structured way.
  • You have had some exposure to managing or coordinating resource, whether a designer, an external partner, or a small team. A proven track record of people management is not required, but some experience of being accountable for others' output is.

why us?

WHAT YOU GET IN RETURN:

  • Fully Remote work based in Portugal
  • A competitive salary
  • Benefits
  • Equipment provided
  • Home office allowance
  • Online Gym and Wellbeing Studio
  • The opportunity for professional growth
  • Fun company events and team outings

AI is fundamentally changing how developers write, understand, debug, and maintain software.

At JetBrains, we're exploring what an AI-native development experience should look like for C++ developers. We are looking for a senior technical leader to help shape this future by building AI-powered workflows, integrating coding agents into developer tools, and defining how CLion can become a first-class environment for AI-assisted software development.

This is a highly hands-on role focused on technical leadership rather than people management. You should expect to spend most of your time prototyping, implementing, and validating AI-powered workflows while helping shape technical direction through hands-on engineering. You'll work at the intersection of developer tools, AI agents, IDE architecture, and product strategy while helping define how software developers work with AI in the future.

Example problems you'll work on:

  • How can coding agents become more effective when working with large C++ codebases?
  • How can CLion's debugging, code understanding, and navigation capabilities be integrated into AI-assisted development workflows?
  • How should AI-powered developer experiences be evaluated and benchmarked in real-world development scenarios?
  • What capabilities should AI agents have access to inside a modern IDE?
  • How can we make CLion a better environment for developers who increasingly collaborate with AI tools and agents?

In this role, you will:

  • Shape and deliver AI-powered features for CLion and C++ development workflows.
  • Design the architecture for AI integrations, agent tools, and C++-specific AI capabilities.
  • Build practical benchmarks and evaluation frameworks for AI-assisted C++ development scenarios.
  • Prototype and validate new AI workflows, including debugging, code understanding, refactoring, and project navigation.
  • Collaborate with product managers, ML engineers, QA engineers, stakeholders, and senior developers to shape and deliver the roadmap.
  • Work closely with JetBrains AI, ML, and product teams to help define the AI strategy for the C++ ecosystem.
  • Evaluate and prioritize AI initiatives, bringing new ideas and proposals that align with the broader JetBrains AI strategy.
  • Contribute hands-on to technical design, software architecture, and implementation in a large, mature codebase.
  • Help define a technical roadmap for AI agent and tool integrations in C++ development workflows.
  • Build trust and alignment across the C++ Ecosystem, AI, Product, QA, and ML organizations

We'd love to talk if you have:

  • Significant software engineering experience as a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, Technical Lead, or similar senior technical role.
  • Strong experience with Kotlin, Java, or other JVM technologies, or the ability to quickly become productive in a JVM-based codebase.
  • Experience building AI-powered products, developer tools, coding assistants, agents, or LLM-based workflows.
  • Strong understanding of how modern coding agents operate, including tool calling, context management, MCP, and evaluation techniques.
  • A track record of driving technical direction in ambiguous and rapidly evolving areas.
  • Strong product instincts and an ability to balance innovation with practical delivery.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence without formal authority.

Nice to have

  • Experience with C++ development workflows, compilers, debuggers, language tooling, or developer productivity products.
  • Experience with IDE internals, language servers, code analysis, refactoring systems, or static analysis.
  • Experience leading small teams or acting as a technical lead.
  • Experience working on AI-native developer products.

Why this role is unique

Rather than building generic chat experiences, you'll be working on challenges such as AI-assisted debugging, agent-powered code understanding, developer workflow automation, and evaluation systems for AI-powered development tools. Your work will directly influence products used by millions of developers worldwide and help shape JetBrains' broader vision for AI-powered software development.

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.

  • Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.

  • Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.
  • Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.
  • Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

*Some benefits may vary depending on location.

raw.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has helped people and teams achieve–well, anything. From seamless work management to smart, scalable solutions, we’ve always worked with flow. We’re building tools that empower teams to automate the manual, uncover insights, and scale smarter. But more than that, we’re creating space– space to think big, take action, and unlock the kind of work that truly matters. Because when challenge meets purpose, and passion turns into progress, that’s magic at work, and it’s what we show up for everyday.

Corporate Systems Engineering builds and operates the software platforms, integrations, and automations that power Smartsheet’s core business functions across Finance, Sales/GTM, and People & Culture. Our team owns mission-critical systems and workflows that enable how the company hires, sells, bills, pays, reports, and scales. We operate at the intersection of software engineering, enterprise platforms, and business-critical data, treating internal systems with the same rigor, reliability, and product mindset as customer-facing software.

The AI & Automation team is our frontier - we're building the next generation of how employees interact with enterprise systems using agentic AI, large language models, and cloud-native automation. This isn't traditional IT. This is product-minded engineering applied to internal tools, with the mandate to fundamentally change how our employees work.

As a Senior Manager, Engineering (AI & Automation), you will lead a team of engineers focused on shipping AI-powered capabilities to employees on a rapid, iterative cadence. This is a hands-on, tech-leaning leadership role where the primary measure of success is delivery velocity — how quickly and effectively your team puts Claude, AWS Bedrock, and other AI tools into the hands of employees to make them measurably more efficient. You will partner closely with Product Management to own the automation roadmap and with Architecture and Data teams to shape our internal AI infrastructure.

This full-time position reports to the Sr. Director, Development and can be located in our Bellevue, WA office, or you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer.

You Will:

  • Lead and grow a team of 4-8 automation engineers across US and offshore locations, responsible for designing, building, and operating automation solutions across Finance, Sales/GTM, People & Culture, and shared corporate workflows.
  • Serve as a hands-on technical contributor (player/coach) — prototyping AI agents, reviewing architecture, and shipping features alongside your team, particularly in early-stage capabilities where speed matters more than delegation.
  • Ship incremental AI-powered features on a regular cadence using Claude, AWS Bedrock, and our internal platform. Your team's primary output is employee-facing AI capabilities - agents that can read, write, and act across enterprise systems through natural language.
  • Partner with Product Management to prioritize the automation roadmap, balancing quick wins that demonstrate value with foundational platform investments. You own delivery; the PM owns prioritization.
  • Design and operate LLM-powered automation pipelines - intelligent search, retrieval-augmented generation, and decision workflows that allow employees to programmatically interact with system data through natural language.
  • Partner with Data Engineering, Architecture, and platform teams to design and evolve our internal knowledge graph, RAG infrastructure, and enterprise search capabilities.
  • Own the internal AI governance model for corporate systems, including the citizen developer framework - the guardrails, enablement resources, quality standards, and compliance controls that allow employees across the business to build with AI safely. This is a leadership responsibility, not a documentation exercise
  • Drive operational excellence across the automation portfolio: sprint execution, CI/CD practices, reliability, SLAs, and data-driven engineering metrics. Build a team that ships predictably and sustainably.
  • Stay at the frontier of AI/automation technologies and bring that perspective into how we work. Challenge existing approaches, advocate for modern patterns, and help the broader organization rethink legacy integrations through an AI-first lens.
  • Contribute to multi-year strategies for automation and AI governance, lifecycle management, platform consolidation, and deprecation of legacy technologies.

You Have:

  • 10+ years experience in software, automation, or systems engineering roles
  • 4+ years management or technical leadership experience with player/coach characteristics
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs - whether that's agentic workflows, retrieval pipelines, prompt engineering at scale, or enterprise AI features. You've shipped something real, not just experimented.
  • Integration development skills using iPaaS or custom code connecting enterprise systems via APIs
  • Experience building or operating enterprise automations against systems such as Workday, NetSuite, Salesforce
  • Experience with AWS or another cloud environment for automation workloads (Bedrock, SNS, SQS, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge)
  • Experience partnering with Product Managers or equivalent business prioritization models
  • Experience supporting data programs, data governance and tooling to support data initiatives
  • Experience implementing or consuming LLM-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, or enterprise search
  • Experience defining execution rituals, backlog management, outcome-based tracking without PM intermediaries
  • Experience building and mentoring engineering talent
  • Experience defining AI governance frameworks, citizen developer programs, or internal platform standards (preferred)
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent practical experience
  • Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

$205,000—$257,500 USD

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Are you an audio editing expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of multimedia understanding. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world‑class education, support creative professionals, and streamline production workflows for studios and audio engineers everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for audio editing specialists who live and breathe sound design, waveform editing, noise reduction, mixing and mastering, multitrack session work, and vocal processing. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like EQ balancing, compression techniques, spatial audio, automation envelopes, DAW workflows, podcast editing, and audio post-production for film—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on editing scenarios and theoretical audio engineering questions, verify technical accuracy and creative logic, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Audio Engineering, Music Production, Acoustics, or a closely related field is ideal; studio experience, a professional editing portfolio, or hands-on work in tools like Pro Tools, Audition, Logic Pro, Reaper, or Ableton Live signals fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your audio expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

Are you a Bedawi language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of linguistic discovery. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline communication for Bedawi speakers everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for Bedawi language specialists who live and breathe Bedawi grammar, syntax, morphology, phonology, semantics, and pragmatics. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like verb conjugation, case system (nominative, accusative, dative, genitive), word order, declensions, gender, and stylistic variation—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on language scenarios, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A bachelor's degree in Bedawi language, linguistics, or a closely related field is ideal, but we also highly value native-level fluency and a deep, practical understanding of the language's nuances. Extensive experience in teaching, translation, or community-based linguistic projects can substitute for a formal degree. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your Bedawi language expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $6-to- $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

This is a remote position.

About the Company
Partnerships drive 30–50% of revenue for modern companies, yet many partner teams still rely on spreadsheets, email, Slack, and outdated CRMs that were never designed for partnership management. This creates inefficiencies, slows growth, and impacts revenue opportunities.
The company is building an AI-native PRM platform designed for modern partnership teams, helping eliminate manual work, improve partner collaboration, and transform partner activity into scalable and measurable revenue growth. The mission is to make partner revenue predictable and scalable.
The organization experienced 600% year-over-year growth in 2025 and currently works with industry-leading companies such as Anthropic, Starlink, Gong, and BambooHR. The team operates in a fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation, execution, and solving large-scale problems in the partner technology space.
About the Role

As our first Director of Sales, you will own the revenue engine. This is not a role for someone who manages from a distance. It's for someone who owns the number, gets involved in key deals when it matters, and builds the playbook and team around what works. You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with the founding team.

You will inherit a team of four Account Executives selling across enterprise and mid-market segments, with a strong track record against established competitors. We have a solid pipeline, a proven sales motion, and customers who buy. Your job is to drive the team's revenue goals, help AEs close larger deals, and build the systems and processes needed to scale from our current stage to $10M, $20M, and $30M+ ARR.

This is a rare opportunity to shape a high-growth sales organization with strong foundations already in place and a product that is winning in the market.

Main Responsibilities
  • Own overall sales targets and be personally accountable for team ARR growth.
  • Coach,enable, and actively support AEs to close more and bigger deals, including jumping into live deals when needed.
  • Lead, develop, and grow a GTM team of Account Executives and SDRs across enterprise and mid-market segments.
  • Build and refine a scalable, repeatable sales playbook from prospecting through close.
  • Define sales processes, qualification frameworks, and pipeline management standards.
  • Partner with the CEO on go-to-market strategy, pricing, and expansion initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline visibility and forecasting in HubSpot.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for improvement and bring forward thoughtful, actionable solutions.
  • Hire and onboard future sales talent as the team scales.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in B2B SaaS sales leadership, ideally having helped take a company from around $5M ARR to $10M, $20M, $30M or beyond.
  • A track record of owning a team number and coaching AEs to consistently exceed quota.
  • Hands-on leadership style. Comfortable jumping into a deal to unstick it, without needing to own a personal quota to stay sharp.
  • Experience building or refining sales processes in an early-stage or high-growth environment.
  • Strong command of both enterprise and mid-market sales motions: cold outreach, discovery, demos, negotiation, and complex deal cycles.
  • Consultative mindset, comfortable asking thoughtful questions, uncovering areas of improvement, and proposing solutions.
  • Highly autonomous. You don't need to be told what to do, you figure out what needs to happen and go do it.
  • Proficiency in HubSpot or equivalent CRM.
  • Self-starter, highly organized, and results-driven.
  • Experience selling PRM, CRM, or partnership software.
  • Familiarity with partner-led or channel sales models.
Why Join Us
  • Build and lead sales organization at a company already proving it can win against the biggest names in the category.
  • Report directly to the CEO with full visibility into company strategy.
  • Be part of a profitable, fast-growing startup with real traction, real logos, and real momentum.
  • No ego, full ownership, entrepreneurial culture.

Benefits

Salary: $5900 - $8900 + OTE
100% Remote from Canada
